item.title: Upcoming Events
item.description:
Christmas Meal 2025

Sunday 14th December 2025

It’s that time of year again… Join us for a heartwarming Christmas meal, spreading joy and cheer in our community. Delicious food, festive music, and good company await. Be a part of the celebration and help us make a difference.

Tickets are available on a first-come, first-served basis at the bargain price of just £20 per person (drinks not included).

For bookings contact: 07702 703882
